title: Kältehilfe Berlin - Quick Summary
kicker: WALK OF BERLIN • LIVING IN BERLIN
items: **The Kältehilfe Berlin season runs from 1 October to 30 April:** about 670 emergency places in October and about 1,000 from November to March.
**Ask first.** Speak to the person politely and ask whether they need anything. They decide whether you call anyone.
**Kältehilfetelefon, 030 343 971 40:** daily from October to April, 19:00 to 23:00, for the question of which shelter to try tonight.
**Kältebus, 030 690 333 690 (20:00 to 2:00) and Wärmebus, 030 600 300 1010 (18:00 to midnight)** drive out every night from November to March, not in October.
**Call 112** when someone does not respond, seems confused or could be in danger. The buses are not an ambulance.
**Most shelters open between 17:00 and 20:00** and close in the morning. Women and families have their own places, and night cafés open only on certain nights.
**Give what shelters ask for:** clean winter clothes, new hygiene items, sleeping bags, wool or fleece blankets, sleeping mats. No bedding, pillows or opened products.
